slice: Location-scoped device-manager CLI and helper writes

implementation.required_scope: List, registration, and health operations require one canonical --location-id UUID before the CLI connects to PostgreSQL.
implementation.query_boundary: Device listing, health lookup, and health upsert bind the selected location. Device lookup accepts the slug or UUID only within that location.
implementation.registration_boundary: An existing device slug may be reactivated or updated only when it already belongs to the requested location. A conflicting cross-location slug is rolled back and rejected.
implementation.offline_boundary: No-operation help and malformed or incomplete operation arguments return before opening a database connection.

generated_inventories: repository inventory (66 capabilities, 66 service groups, 459 test files, zero parse errors)

limitations: The location UUID filters database selection but does not authenticate the operator or establish a tenant grant.
This does not prove least-privilege database access or application RLS.
No candidate or legacy database, device, provider, or persisted schedule was accessed.
